label: Bible Study
prompt: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in _____ made with hands;
verse: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
note: Paul on Mars' Hill, surrounded by Athens' idols — the Creator doesn't live in buildings.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Grace be with you, _____, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verse: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
note: John's greeting hands over three gifts at once — grace, mercy, and peace — in truth and love.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of _____ was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
verse: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his God.
note: Daniel came up from the den without a scratch, 'because he believed in his God.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be _____.
verse: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
note: Paul even includes himself and angels — the gospel's content outranks any messenger's credentials.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way _____.
verse: Yet there shall be a space between you and it, about two thousand cubits by measure: come not near unto it, that ye may know the way by which ye must go: for ye have not passed this way heretofore.
note: Follow the ark and keep your distance so you can see the way — 'for ye have not passed this way heretofore.'
